  "phoneNote": "The bold emergency message and prominent phone number work well, but repeated address and opening-hours blocks make the lower page unnecessarily long.",

    "Correct the navigation positioning so it stays at the viewport top without obscuring hero text or the phone number in the full-page views.",
    "Consolidate the address, directions and opening hours into one contact section; remove the duplicated block immediately before the phone footer.",
    "Reduce desktop hero and section-heading sizes, shrink the phone-number plate, and tighten the service-area section so the page has a more balanced rhythm."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone hero, full-page view: the navigation bar overlaps the description and partially hides the phone-number plate.",

  ]
